reading.body:
This Meta facility in Utah County has no published power capacity, and therefore does not contribute to the 52.18 MW of published data center capacity mapped in Utah. The facility exists on OpenStreetMap as one of 21 mapped data centers in the state, but ranks tenth among the nine facilities with disclosed specifications, meaning its capacity is either zero or withheld.

Meta operates this campus as part of its owned and operated data center program, which the company has expanded at scale in recent years, most notably with a 10 billion dollar investment announced in December 2024 for a separate facility in Louisiana. No opening date, investment figure, building count, square footage, or power draw for this specific Utah location was found in available published sources, despite repeated searches of Wikipedia and state level materials.

Without published specifications, this campus cannot be evaluated for its role in AI scaling. The absence of disclosed capacity figures across most Utah facilities, where only 9 of 21 mapped data centers publish power numbers, limits visibility into the state's total computational footprint. To assess whether this Meta site matters to AI infrastructure, its power capacity would need to be published.
